verdict.rationale: Render's own homepage directly offers migration credits for moving production infrastructure, which matches the story exactly: "Get up to $10K in migration credits." The evidence is a single marketing line, so the terms and process are not shown. Missing for 10: eligibility criteria and application/redemption process documentation, credit terms (expiry, scope), independent or hands-on corroboration of receiving credits.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can receive migration credits when moving my production infrastructure to a new platform

citations.quote: Get up to $10K in migration credits.
